title: The Unpronounceable Professor explains Litecoin Virtual Machine.
description: The Litecoin DeFi era beginning in 2026, LitecoinVM, short for Litecoin Virtual Machine, an upcoming upgrade poised to revolutionize the network. This EVM-compatible zkRollup-based omnichain layer introduces new smart contract capabilities, evolving Litecoin into a full-fledged Web3 platform. LitVM leverages zero-knowledge (ZK) proofs to enable scalable, secure, and privacy-focused operations while maintaining Litecoin's core strengths.

asr.full_text: welcome to my light coin show i am professor ungutue ntesetwe nkeshe mbara akwe and today i want to tell you about lit vm aka litecoin's web three era little vm is a zero knowledge omni chain solution built on top of litecoin in order to allow for smart contract functionalities cross-chain interoperabilities and web3 features. In laymen terms it is a L2 solution that is about to transform 0 knowledge to find X amount of money in litecoin. You need zero knowledge to understand exactly what it's about to bring to Litecoin. So what is it about to bring to Litecoin? Lead VM will allow us to be able to build DeFi protocols, Table coins, NFT platforms, payment rails, real world asset tokenization protocols. And even move assets between Litecoin,ereum bitcoin and other chains it is powered by stack of technologies that include bitcoin os for trustless bridging and roll of settlements polygon cdk for evm compatible smart contracts capabilities and ad layer for crustian interoperability and unified liquidity in a nutshell litvm is lit and so are you and i will see you in the next episode
